item.title: Desert Dubs Fest #5: 500+ VWs to gather for charity
item.description: Desert Dubs Fest #5 will bring over 500 air-cooled Volkswagens to Tumbleweed Park in Chandler on Saturday, featuring a custom-built 1967 VW Baja Beetle giveaway, food, a DJ, and raffle prizes, all to raise money for Phoenix Children's Hospital.

item.title: Partnership provides resources & support for cancer caregivers
item.description: Arizona Myeloma Network and Bulletproof partner to provide resources and support for cancer caregivers, addressing the impact of diagnosis on families.

item.title: Shamrock Farms marks Kindness Day with free gifts and donations
item.description: Shamrock Farms celebrated National Random Act of Kindness Day.

item.title: Purse-Impressions: Dignity for women in recovery
item.description: Purse-Impressions, a nonprofit, provides dignity to women in recovery by distributing purses and backpacks filled with essentials.

item.title: Arizona's 100 Club raises funds for firefighter cancer prevention
item.description: The 100 Club of Arizona has launched a $700,000 fundraising campaign to provide cancer-prevention equipment for every fire truck in the state, which includes "storm sticks" designed to reduce carcinogen exposure for firefighters.

item.title: Rare baby Pygmy Hippo born at Wildlife World Zoo
item.description: Wildlife World Zoo, Aquarium & Safari Park has announced the birth of a female baby pygmy hippo, an endangered species, and is inviting the public to help name the new calf through a community vote.

item.title: Black Theater Troupe honors Black History Month with 'Jitney'
item.description: The Black Theater Troupe is set to perform "Jitney," a powerful play directed by Rachel Finley that celebrates Black History Month and highlights the resilience and unity of a community of unsanctioned cab drivers in Pittsburgh.

item.title: Aviation Institute of Maintenance readies students for aerospace jobs
item.description: The Aviation Institute of Maintenance in Phoenix offers a 21-month hands-on program that prepares students for high-paying careers in the aerospace industry, with graduates earning starting salaries of $70,000 to $80,000.

item.title: Angel numbers 101: Your guide to spiritual alignment and growth
item.description: Angel numbers are believed to have different meanings, ranging from new beginnings and balance to protection, transformation, and abundance, and are seen as signs of divine communication and support.Angel numbers are believed to have different meanings, ranging from new beginnings and balance to protection, transformation, and abundance, and are seen as signs of divine communication and support.

item.title: Queen Creek Olive Mill gears up for annual Garlic Festival
item.description: The Queen Creek Olive Mill is hosting its annual garlic festival, showcasing 17,000 organic bulbs grown on the property, and offers visitors a farm-to-table experience with tours, olive oil tastings, and citrus products.
